The card doubles the 2 shared neighbors to 4 and divides by the summed degrees 3 + 4 = 7: Dice similarity 0.571." width="100%"} The Dice coefficient measures similarity between two nodes based on their neighborhood overlap: `Dice(A, B) = 2 × |neighbors(A) ∩ neighbors(B)| / (|neighbors(A)| + |neighbors(B)|)` Range: `[0, 1]` where `0` means no common neighbors and `1` means identical neighborhoods (or same node). Self-similarity is always `1.0`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, dict[int, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Nested dictionary mapping node IDs to dictionaries of similarity scores. Format: `{node1_id: {node2_id: similarity_score}}`. ::: ## Common Use Cases {.doc-common-use-cases} - link prediction (similar nodes likely to connect) - community detection (nodes with similar neighborhoods) - recommendation systems (find similar users/items) ## Examples {.doc-examples} "A" and "D" both connect to "B" and "C", so their neighborhoods overlap completely -- Dice rates that as a perfect `1.0` similarity: ::: {#1a7c7819 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_nodes(["A", "B", "C", "D"]) .add_edges([("A", "B"), ("A", "C"), ("D", "B"), ("D", "C")]) ) sim = graph.dice_similarity() a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") d_id = graph.get_id_from_label("D") sim[a_id][d_id] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1.0 ``` ::: :::
